title: Oliver proves his prowess in new music, "Wishing Star"
htmlContent:
Oliver has continued to develop his craft ever since embarking on his career. The Philippine-based star Oliver has continued to develop his skills and is currently making waves, especially with the release of his recent song "Wishing Star." His current single, "Wishing Star," is a vital and honest song. 

Oliver's "Wishing Star" is an Owl City-inspired pop ballad about soldiering on even during the most challenging times because life does get better. The art of music is on full display for us all to enjoy, with a masterpiece being brought for us all to witness.
